title: 第25章 离婚协议书第26章 少奶奶的命
lines: 第25章离婚协议书
夏明华他怎么敢？
顾不得其他，挂掉杨素素电话，夏天直接下了楼，佣人也没有想到夏天会起的那么早。
“少夫人早。”
只是夏天根本没有其他的心思，直接朝外面走了去，也顾不得脚踝痛不痛。
急匆匆的直奔夏宅，而就在夏天走了不久，权天睿晨练就回来了，到了房间居然没有看到夏天的人，以为她下楼吃了饭。
只是到了楼下，便得知夏天急匆匆了走了出去，权天睿不知为何，直觉有什么事情。
直接给李锦打了电话，“查一下少夫人现在具体的位置。”
而他自己，则是直接去了车库。
她什么都可以不用在乎，但是唯独她妈妈不能不在乎。
本来以为妈妈死了，夏明华就能放过她妈妈，放过自己了。
却没有想到，居然连她妈妈想要有个长眠之地都是那样的奢望。
一路上夏天心急如焚，恨不得长了翅膀飞向夏宅，生怕自己去晚了，夏明华去了墓地。
那个男人，狠心到什么都能做的出来。
夏天一下车，几乎是朝夏宅飞奔而去。
见到是夏天回来了，管家神色很是激动，显然没有料想到夏天会回来。
“大小姐，你怎么回来了。”
如果是以前的夏天兴许还会跟他说上几句话，毕竟管家可是看着她从小到大的。
没有理会管家的招呼，直接进了屋子，朝夏明华的书房走去。
只是刚刚走到楼梯处，便遇到刚刚起床的夏青荷。
见到夏天回来，似乎一点也不意外。
反倒是脸上荡起柔柔的笑意。“姐姐今天怎么回来那么早。”只是双眸之中，淬毒一般的阴狠。
夏天显然没有心情跟夏青荷在这里玩什么心机。
“让开。”
也不等夏青荷反应，直接上前推开了站在自己前面这个碍眼的人。
只是……
夏青荷的身子却直接朝楼梯上滚了下去，不知道何时在她身后出现的陆翊，连忙伸手接住了夏青荷。
将夏青荷抱起来，对夏天怒目而视，那模样恨不得生吞活剥夏天似得。
夏天低头看了看自己的手，她有没有用力，自己比谁都清楚，就算他不相信又如何？
她也没有必要跟这些人解释什么，都是一丘之貉。
这时候，书房内的夏明华听到声音，也打开了书房的房门，看到夏天到来，眼眸之中的那一抹亮色，没有瞒过夏天的双眼。
“大清早的，吵什么吵，陆翊难得来我们家歇息，你们这样吵吵，也不怕惊扰了客人。”
对此，夏天只是讽刺一笑。
深深的看了一眼夏青荷，能让陆翊在夏家睡觉，大多数的功劳怕是她的主意。

Chapter 25 Divorce Agreement
"What..."
Xia Minghua, how dare he?
Not caring about anything else, he hung up Yang Susu's phone and went downstairs directly. The servant did not expect that Xia Tian would get up so early.
"Good morning, madam."
It's just that Xia Tian didn't have other thoughts at all and walked directly outside, regardless of whether his ankle hurt or not.
He hurried straight to Xia's house, and not long after Xia Tian left, Quan Tianrui came back from morning exercises. When he got to the room, he didn't see Xia Xia, thinking that she went downstairs to eat.
Just when they got downstairs, they learned that Xia Tian had hurriedly walked out. Quan Tianrui didn't know why, but he had an intuition that something was wrong.
He called Li Jin directly and said, "Check the specific location of the young lady."
As for himself, he went directly to the garage.
She didn't have to care about anything, but her mother couldn't care less.
She originally thought that if her mother died, Xia Minghua would be able to let her mother go and let herself go.
But she didn't expect that even her mother's desire to have a resting place was such an extravagant wish.
Xia Minghua was so anxious along the way that he wished he could grow wings and fly to Xia's house. He was afraid that he would be late and Xia Minghua went to the cemetery.
That man is so cruel that he can do anything.
When Xia Tian got out of the car, he almost ran towards Xia Zhai.
Seeing that Xia Tian was back, the housekeeper looked very excited, obviously he did not expect that Xia Tian would come back.
"Miss, why are you back?"
If it were Xia Tian in the past, she might have said a few words to him. After all, the housekeeper had watched her grow up.
Ignoring the housekeeper's greeting, he entered the room directly and walked towards Xia Minghua's study.
Just as he reached the stairs, he met Xia Qinghe who had just gotten up.
Seeing Xia Tian coming back didn't seem surprising at all.
Instead, a soft smile appeared on his face. "Sister, why did you come back so early today?" There was a viciousness in his eyes that was like quenching poison.
Xia Tian was obviously not in the mood to play tricks with Xia Qinghe here.
"Get out of the way."
Without waiting for Xia Qinghe's reaction, he stepped forward and pushed away the eyesore standing in front of him.
Just...
Xia Qinghe's body rolled directly down the stairs. Lu Yi, who didn't know when he appeared behind her, quickly reached out to catch Xia Qinghe.
"Qinghe..."
He picked up Xia Qinghe and glared at Xia Tian, as if he wanted to eat Xia Tian alive.
Xia Tian lowered his head and looked at his hand. He knew better than anyone whether she had exerted any force. So what if he didn't believe it?
There was no need for her to explain anything to these people, they were all the same.
At this time, Xia Minghua in the study room heard the sound and opened the door of the study room. Seeing Xia Tian's arrival, the bright color in his eyes did not hide from Xia Tian's eyes.
"It's so early in the morning, why are you making such a fuss? It's rare for Lu Yi to come to our house to rest. If you make such a noise, you won't be afraid of disturbing the guests."
In this regard, Xia Tian just smiled sarcastically.
After taking a deep look at Xia Qinghe, most of the credit for getting Lu Yi to sleep at Xia's house was probably her idea.
